files.extraction: Original MailIndexSnapshot/IndexedMailThread model, sanitization, create/merge/remove, Microsoft immutable-ID migration check and Gmail normalization helpers.
adaptations: Exports the original 100,000-thread cap and retains Gmail sourceMessageId.
Uses Edition 3 encrypted transactional storage instead of the predecessor EncryptedMailIndexStore, file envelope or key handling. No predecessor store or runtime is opened.
Original Gmail index searches summary metadata (subject/sender/labels), not full message bodies. Full selected-message reading remains a separate original workflow.
